verdict.rationale: Discord's docs explicitly cover modals ('single-user pop-up interfaces that allow apps to collect form-like data'), buttons ('clickable components... styles, texts, emoji'), and application/slash commands, all part of the Interactions framework for building rich in-chat UI. Missing for 10: no hands-on/independent developer corroboration of building these interactions, and no detail on other structured layout components like select menus or embeds beyond what's cited.
